therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibition combined with DNA synthesis inhibition and DNA crosslinking
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation inhibition through multiple pathways
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with advanced chemo-naïve pancreatic cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: response rate (partial and complete response, stable disease, and progressive disease)

results.dose_information: erlotinib 100 mg orally daily starting day 1, Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 in 10 mg/m2/min (100 minutes) infusion on day 1 followed on day 2 by oxaliplatin 100 mg/m2 in a 2-hour infusion, repeated every 2 weeks

context.duration: 12 cycles (24 weeks) with potential continuation until maximum response, then erlotinib maintenance
